description: Override contract: column overrides to defined types over basic kinds (Label string, Count int64, Ratio float64, Flag bool, Blob []byte) and json.RawMessage on a text column, netip.Addr on inet, nullable columns read and written as pointers, and a SQL type override on text reaching a text[] column's elements; seeded rows are read back and found by each value as a parameter, and rows written by exec, batch and copyfrom are found and listed. pgx scans and encodes every one of these through its type map, so the generated code converts nothing; the case holds pgx to the same contract as the other emitters.
